title: INCREDIBLE: INCREmental DIalysis and diet for a Better Life Experience; Clinical relevance of an “add-on” Ketosteril supplementation on incremental haemodialysis period in incident haemodialysis patients. An exploratory randomized controlled trial
official: INCREDIBLE: INCREmental DIalysis and diet for a Better Life Experience; Clinical relevance of an “add-on” Ketosteril supplementation on incremental haemodialysis period in incident haemodialysis patients. An exploratory randomized controlled trial
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of the addition of Ketosteril to the usual nutritional plan to patients who start incremental haemodialysis with respect to the end-point duration of the incremental haemodialysis period
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patients (aged 18 years or older)
2. Able and accepting to give informed consent
3. Starting incremental Haemodialysis in the Centre Hospitalier Le Mans
Exclusion criteria:
1. Denying informed consent
2. Previous enrolment in a randomized study using Ketosteril
3. Currently enrolled in another interventional clinical trial
4. Protected by law (patient under guardianship, minor, prisoner, pregnant or breastfeeding woman, …)
5. Acute kidney injury (AKI)
6. Life expectancy of less than 3 months, or kidney transplantation scheduled within 3 months
7. Cognitive impairment severe enough to limit understanding and acceptance of the study
8. Impossibility to regain kidney function (bilateral nephrectomy, documented irreversible complete destruction of the kidney tissue)
9. Patient with genetic disease affecting amino acid metabolism
10. Hypercalcemia defined as calcemia beyond the upper limit of normality according to the laboratory where the test is performed and persisting for at least one month
11. Hypersensitivity to the active substances or to any of the excipients of Ketosteril
12. Non-compliance to dialysis prescription
